verdict.rationale: Honeycomb's MCP integration lets connected AI agents 'investigate and diagnose latency or error spikes' and 'identify performance outliers,' which can produce ad hoc AI-generated incident context, and Query Assistant translates natural language into queries, but there is no first-party feature that auto-generates incident summaries or alert context natively within triggers/SLOs. missing for 10: native AI-generated incident summary/alert-annotation feature (not dependent on external MCP agent), evidence of automatic contextualization attached to triggers/SLOs.
